answer: Where did the yarrow come from? Who painted the shale? When was the mesa finished? The farm answers the first two and chokes on the third. Every applicant faces the same trial, Puppetmaker toy horse mark counted beside the toy shop, and every verdict reads the same way: each toy horse is a count of whittled joints checked beside the paint mark. One agent spends 20 minutes and is done; the farm spends 13840 minutes and ends with nothing to sell. The paint log, read once, ends arguments that a hundred assurances cannot.
